description: Render a page's animation timelines to an MP4 video. The page's scripts must expose `window.__timelines` — objects with `duration()` and `pause(t)` (a paused gsap.timeline registered there works as-is). Each frame seeks every timeline to t=i/fps and paints the viewport, so the output is deterministic — no wall clock in the pixel values. Audio: `narration[]` places TTS/voice clips at start times (mixed into one AAC track), `audio` adds looped background music, and `subtitles_srt` muxes an SRT as a soft mov_text track and (by default, `burn_subtitles: false` to opt out) burns the same cues into the frame pixels — QuickTime, WeChat and most social embeds ignore the soft track. Requires ffmpeg on the server. Returns base64 MP4 (H.264, yuv420p) plus frame count and durations.

RenderNarrationClip.description:
render_video `narration[]`: one voiceover clip placed at a start time —
generate with any TTS, hand us the URL; all clips mix into one AAC track.

start_secs.description: Seconds from video t=0 where this line starts. Default 0.

url.description: URL of the voice clip (any TTS output; mp3/wav/ogg/m4a).

RenderVideoAudio.description:
render_video `audio`: background music track — fetched, looped to cover
the video, volume-scaled, optionally faded out at the end.

fade_out_secs.description: Fade out over the final N seconds. Default 0 (none).

loop_audio.description: Loop to cover the whole video. Default true.

url.description: URL of the music file. mp3/wav/ogg/m4a — probed by content.

audio.description:
Background music: looped to cover the video, volume-scaled, faded
out at the tail.

burn_subtitles.description:
Burn the cues into the frame pixels too (hardsub) — on by default
when `subtitles_srt` is present; QuickTime, WeChat and most social
embeds ignore the soft mov_text track. `false` keeps the soft track
only.

height.description: Viewport height in CSS pixels. Default 720.

hold_tail_secs.description: Freeze the final timeline state for this many extra seconds. Default 0.5.

max_duration_secs.description: Safety cap on timeline + hold tail, seconds. Default 120.

narration.description:
Voiceover clips, each starting at its own time (any TTS output;
mixed into one AAC track).

subtitles_language.description: ISO language tag for the subtitle track, e.g. "eng" / "zh".

subtitles_srt.description: Inline SRT subtitles muxed as a soft (toggleable) mov_text track.

url.description:
Page URL whose scripts register timelines in `window.__timelines`
(GSAP-style objects with `duration()` + `pause(t)`).

use_proxy.description: Route through proxy (for blocked foreign sites)

wait_timelines_ms.description: How long to wait for `window.__timelines` to appear, ms. Default 10000.

width.description: Viewport width in CSS pixels (floored to even — yuv420p). Default 1280.

name: render_video
